notes.title: WN_RPG 1B Playtest
notes.notes:
After the playtest, we would appreciate your cooperation in completing a survey.

"WN_RPG 1B Playtest"
Game Overview:

Playtime: Approximately 7 to 15 hours
Language: Japanese only
Save function available
The in-game menu has a link to the survey site (Google Forms).
If you find any typos, errors, or bugs, please report them through the survey or on the "WN_RPG 1B" message board.
Testing period: Until around 7 PM on April 20 (Japan time) or until further notice without prior announcement.

 If you go to the "WN_RPG 1B" store page, you will see a "Play Now" button.

notes.title: WN_RPG 1B DEMO has been released!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that the exclusive WN_RPG 1B DEMO is now available for download.
The demo version can be downloaded from the [b] " Download " button[/b] under " [b]Download WN_RPG 1B Demo[/b] " on the store page " [b]WN_RPG 1B[/b] ".
Your feedback is crucial. If you encounter typographical errors or problems, please report them to the " [b]DEMO版不具合報告 DEMO version problem report[/b] " on the  discussions.
We eagerly anticipate your participation and look forward to working with you.
